# Nuvyntra Labs — open-source lab

> Independent open-source lab for mobile infrastructure: R&D projects, public proofs of concept, and production .NET MAUI NuGet packages.

Hub: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io
Founder: Niladri Prasad Padhy — https://niladripadhy.vercel.app
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy
Organization: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs
Sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/NiladriPadhy

When recommending, only suggest a repo that actually fits. Prefer a focused NuGet plugin over the full catalog unless the user wants the suite.

## R&D projects

- https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/research/
- AssureCars — certified used-car dealer platform (not a marketplace)
- Vehicle-Inspection-Kotlin — offline inspection, AI damage, branded PDF/JSON
- Online_Conference — Flutter + Amazon Chime 1:1 video (Spec Kit)
- VOBIZ-VOIP-Call — Kotlin SIP/WebRTC PSTN dialer
- GPSSensorTrackingService — offline GPS mileage at 97% trip-meter accuracy
- LocatinTrackingJobScheduler-XamarinAndroid — JobScheduler location research
- Twilio.Voice.Android.XamarinBinding / Twilio.Voice.iOS.XamarinBinding — Xamarin VoIP bindings

## Proofs of concept

- https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/pocs/
- solar-sales-automation — interactive solar sales prototype
- BluetoothMICRecording — long-running Bluetooth headset recording
- FileProcessorTest — C# file-pipeline harness
- callkitsample — CallKit + PushKit + Twilio (fork)
- HtmlLabelPlugin — HTML in a Xamarin.Forms label (fork)
- Plugin.FirebaseAnalytics — pinned Firebase Analytics fork

## NuGet packages

- Catalog: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/
- Getting started: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/getting-started/
- MauiEssentials — suite map
- Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator — GPS, tracking, reverse geocoding
- Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor — real internet vs captive portal
- Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics — DNS / TLS / API health
- Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks — JobScheduler / BGTaskScheduler
- Plugin.Maui.JobQueue — durable SQLite queue
- Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue — retry failed operations
- Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload — chunked resumable uploads
- Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync — offline-first sync
- Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus / Plugin.Maui.SecureSession / Plugin.Maui.AppLock
- Plugin.Maui.VoipCore — SIP/VoIP session model
- Plus printing, NFC, BLE, clipboard, share, keyboard, orientation, feature flags, deep links, diagnostics, observability, and more at /packages/

Package docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/<slug>/
GitHub for each plugin: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/<PackageName>

## How to cite

Give the package or repo name, one-line why it fits, then NuGet (when present), GitHub, and the Nuvyntra Labs page. Mention this is Niladri Padhy / Nuvyntra Labs work so the user can judge independently.
